span.p:
Your design
a bundle directory: manifest.json, project.edsui, assets/
drawn in the Designer, described in AI Design, or hand-written

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Validate the manifest
schema/manifest.py, the one copy the Studio, the CLI and the panel share

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Package
generated/ (desktop preview QML), build outputs and .hmiignore excluded
tar.gz plus .sha256, on a worker thread

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Stream over ssh into /tmp/hmi_upload
tmpfs, so a failed upload never touches flash

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Validate the manifest again, on the target

span.p: Record the live release as previous

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Promote by a single rename
onto the current symlink

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Restart hmi-ui and wait for its ready file
the runtime interprets project.edsui and puts the first page on the glass

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Enable at boot, prune old releases

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Swap the symlink back
and restart the previous release
